summary: Relationship backfill for the 21 person entries with three relationships or fewer at 1.234: 32 new edges, 18 of them between two people, each independently reviewed (review-A.json, review-BC.json; 19 accepted with edits). Mary Jane Logan McCallum gains 8: co-author with Adele Perry (Structures of Indifference, 2018) and with Robert Alexander Innes, Philip J. Deloria's argument as the frame of her 2009 article, and contributions to labour, women's and gender, medical and Indigenous-authored history and settler colonialism. Others: Jonathan Israel 3; Peter Gay 3; Robert Alexander Innes 3; Anthony D. Smith 2; Charles E. Rosenberg 2; Sheila Fitzpatrick 2; Anthony Giddens 1; E. H. Carr 1; Gilles Deleuze 1; J. R. Miller 1; Joanna Bourke 1; Patrick J. Geary 1; Paul Thompson 1; Robert Bartlett 1; Samuel P. Huntington 1. No new edge for Haunani-Kay Trask, D’Arcy McNickle, Aldo Leopold, Rachel Carson, Barbara H. Rosenwein: their leads were unreadable through authorised routes or already represented. Held: bhr_rel_01, bhr_rel_02, rc_rel_01 (reading route or teaching-use only), with reasons in the drafts.
authorization: User, 2026-10-31: “Mary Jane Logan McCallum edges are very small; she coauthored a book with Perry”; “Rosenberg is missing all together”; then “push and review all the low edge historians”. The 21 person entries with three relationships or fewer at revision 1.234 were researched by three dedicated researchers under data/field-research/stedman-jones-relationships-2026-10-25/review-protocol.md and the brief data/extension-2026/thin-person-edges-2026-10-31/BRIEF.md, and every proposal was checked by an independent reviewer (review-A.json, review-BC.json). Only accepted proposals, with the reviewer's edits, are applied; held proposals stay in the drafts with include: false and their reasons.
rationale: Existing endpoints only; no new nodes, biographies, life facts, chronology or identity notes. Each edge rests on a fresh reading recorded with locators and limits (abstract-only, publisher-description and named-reader routes are labelled as such). Topic similarity is never evidence. OCAP rules applied to McCallum, Innes, Trask and McNickle (scholarship and collaborations only; community-controlled sites paraphrased). Old graph records are unchanged apart from append-only source reading notes.
